title: The Shop
subtitle: Everything here costs something
description: This chapter sets `defaultConsumeItems` true, so every item task in it
takes the goods unless the task says otherwise. That is the inheritance
the field exists for: a trade chapter where handing in means handing over
says it once, here, rather than on six tasks that would each be repeating
One quest below opts out. It is the exception that shows the rule is a
default rather than a fact about the chapter.
